author: Alcott Wei
description:
A group of Chinese officials are in the middle of a highly sensitive meeting involving critical decisions yet to be made behind closed doors, with documents stamped “classified” spread across the table.
Suddenly, an invisible laser beams into the room, sweeping across a glass window and allowing the contents of the meeting to be transmitted elsewhere.
China’s Ministry of State Security laid out this seemingly futuristic scenario six months ago, warning government departments and other entities...
title: From laser shields to iPhone detectors: inside China’s booming secrecy industry

author: Dewey Sim,Alyssa Chen
description:
China is likely to view the latest US dealings with Russia as “transactional”, according to observers, who said Beijing was likely to wait and see what the longer-term impact would be given the possibility that Donald Trump might abruptly change course again.
The US president announced that under a deal with Vladimir Putin, Russia would “immediately” supply more than 300,000 tonnes of diesel to the US and global markets.
He wrote on social media that another 500,000 tonnes would follow in...
title: Why China is likely to be cautious about recent Trump-Putin diesel deal

author: Phoebe Zhang
description:
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi will visit Azerbaijan and three Balkan countries amid Beijing’s push to shore up its trade corridors and geopolitical influence in the regions.
Wang will attend the seventh summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence-Building Measures in Asia (CICA) in Baku, Azerbaijan, on Thursday “as special representative of President Xi Jinping”, according to China’s foreign ministry.
Aside from Azerbaijan, Beijing’s top diplomat will visit Croatia, Montenegro and...
title: China’s top diplomat to visit Azerbaijan, Croatia, Montenegro and Bulgaria to boost ties

author: Gabriel Dominguez
description:
The US Navy aims to field a relatively low-cost hypersonic missile on its carrier-based fighters, a weapon that could pose a new challenge to the air defences protecting Chinese warships and coastal military installations, experts said.
California-based defence company Castelion’s Blackbeard is designed to fly at more than five times the speed of sound and strike ships and land targets. Unlike more expensive hypersonic weapons, it is being developed with an emphasis on affordability and mass...
title: US turns to low-cost Blackbeard hypersonic missiles to overwhelm Chinese defences

author: Lawrence Chung
description:
Taiwan’s defence ministry plans to allow military pilots to serve until the age of 58 as it grapples with the prospect of “having fighter jets but no pilots”.
The proposed retention scheme comes as the island’s air force prepares to form operational squadrons around 66 new F-16V Block 70 fighters ordered from the United States, adding pressure to an already stretched pool of experienced pilots.
Under the plan, pilots could serve until 58 – up from about 48 for lieutenant colonels and 52 for...
title: Taiwan aims to raise pilot retirement age to 58 as new F-16V jets arrive

author: Neil Denslow,Raymond Ma
description:
China agreed to cut millions of hybrid car exports to the European Union over the next four years, easing simmering trade tensions ahead of a key meeting of European leaders later this week.
The deal will slow exports to half or less the pace currently predicted by the EU, the bloc’s trade chief, Maros Sefcovic, told a press conference in Beijing on Friday after two days of negotiations. Next year alone, it will pare shipments by up to 700,000 vehicles and trim as much as €14 billion (US$16...
title: China-EU car deal eases trade tensions for now at least

author: Stephen Chen,Victoria Bela
description:
China has begun building the world’s first utility-scale power plant combining two emerging technologies: supercritical carbon dioxide (CO2) generation and large-scale molten salt energy storage.
The Ruitan project, under construction at a coal-fired power station in Yantai in eastern China’s Shandong province, is intended to demonstrate how combining these technologies can reduce energy wastage and improve the stability of the electrical grid. Electricity produced when demand is low is stored...
title: China bets on molten salt and CO2 to help meet its power needs

author: Caroline Lin
description:
Beijing is rapidly scaling up the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to produce short-form videos and microdramas in its publicity campaigns, aligning with directives stressing technology’s role in strengthening ideological work and guiding public opinion.
In contrast to sensational tropes dominating AI content across Chinese media platforms – such as Cinderella romance, rebirth for revenge and post-apocalyptic survival – a new wave of AI-generated miniseries weaves Chinese culture, policies...
title: How China harnesses AI microdramas to shape public opinion at home and abroad

author: Carol Yang
description:
Beijing on Monday sanctioned Paraguayan and Belizean government ministers over the Taiwan issue, after the two nations sealed deals with Taipei in recent months.
Gustavo Villate, Paraguay’s minister of information and communication technologies, and Francis Fonseca, Belize’s minister of foreign affairs, foreign trade, education, culture, science and technology were placed under sanctions from Monday, the foreign ministry said.
The measures include freezing their assets within China, prohibiting...
title: Beijing sanctions Paraguayan and Belizean ministers over support for Taiwan

author: Dannie Peng
description:
A large desalination plant on Bohai Bay has achieved an energy efficiency breakthrough, slashing electricity consumption by more than half while converting millions of tonnes of toxic waste brine into high-value chemical salt.
Situated in the Caofeidian industrial zone of Tangshan, Hebei province, the facility recently entered its trial production stage, the state-run Science and Technology Daily reported last month.
This technology provides a viable pathway to solving the global challenge of...
title: Chinese desalination plant cuts 60% energy use by turning waste brine into industrial salt

description:
